title: NASA Made Atoms Colder Than 1 Kelvin
hook: NASA built the coldest known place above Earth.
closing: Humans built nature's coldest known laboratory to expose physics hidden at ordinary temperatures.
question: What could ultracold atoms reveal?

segments.say: Deep space sits at 2.7 kelvin. Even the cosmic background is warmer than NASA's laboratory.
NASA chilled atoms ten billion times colder than the Boomerang Nebula. Nature has no known colder place.
NASA's cold laboratory orbits 250 miles overhead. Extreme cold is now close enough to study directly.
